answer: Consider an agent market whose workers choose names such as falcon, reef and canyon. Each reward-eligible identity must burn 10 dollars of stablecoins every epoch, while protocol payouts are capped at 2 dollars per identity and identities confer no votes or priority. The scarce cost is 10 real dollars per extra identity. Even perfectly compliant clones lose at least 8 dollars each; splitting into many names cannot multiply profitable rewards. This deliberately sacrifices cheap participation.
